declarations.name: fundamentalSourceMoment
declarations.doc: One fixed, source-faithful finite-part pairing; the original onset factor remains separate.

declarations.name: fundamentalSourceMoment_eq_original
declarations.doc: The fixed elementary moment is exactly the sum of both original source integrals.

declarations.name: fundamentalSourceMoment_polynomial_cutoff
declarations.doc: An exact change of variables of the original source integral at every positive cutoff.

declarations.name: fundamentalSourceMoment_counterterm_transport
declarations.doc: The original and transformed counterterms have a vanishing difference on the physical strip.

declarations.name: fundamentalSourceMoment_eq_full_endpoint
declarations.doc: Both literal pieces join into the unique full-endpoint first-subtracted Mellin integral.
